title: Shade, Gus Cannon, and the other jug bands
summary: Lewis was with Shade and traveled with Gus Cannon to New York, though not in the jug band; another band was led by a harmonica player called Ham.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I know Gus Cannon and Shade. I got records by them with the jugs. Who else was there?
Well, see, I was with Shade. Gus Cannon, I went with him, but not in the jug band. I and Gus was in New York together. Me and him and a cellar called Mrs. Willie B.
That was a year before that.
But I mean, back when you got started on the guitar, I'm talking about, back in those times, you said they had quite a few jug bands.
Shade and Cannon and who else?
Well, the fella called Ham, he had one. But now...
Ham the harmonica player, or what did he play?
He played harmonica, that's right. Sure was. But now all them boys, them boys ain't dead, they're out of town. It's been a year since I see them. Yeah. Yeah.
